bio: Nioko has always loved snakes, so when she came face-to-face with the Great Serpent Rasoth, she wasn’t quite as scared as she probably should have been. She accepted Rasoth's Fangs, unconcerned with its mentions of curses and hunters. So now Nioko has some nice daggers… and a whole lot of enemies.
